tasks.spec: Records: Person {name: Text}, Greeting {text: Text}. Workflow main(person: Person) -> Greeting returns text equal to "Hello, " followed by the person's name followed by "!".
Records: Rect {width: Number, height: Number}, Shape {area: Number, perimeter: Number}. Workflow main(rect: Rect) -> Shape returns the rectangle's area and perimeter.

Records: Exam {score: Number}, Grade {letter: Text, passed: Bool}. Workflow main(exam: Exam) -> Grade. letter is "A" for a score of 90 or more, "B" for 75 or more, "C" for 50 or more, otherwise "F". passed is true when the score is 50 or more.
Records: Numbers {values: Number[]}, Total {sum: Number, count: Number}. Workflow main(numbers: Numbers) -> Total returns the sum of the values and how many values there are.
Records: Request {n: Number}, Result {value: Number}. Workflow main(request: Request) -> Result returns the factorial of n. n is a whole number from 0 to 10.
Record: Numbers {values: Number[]}. Workflow main(numbers: Numbers) -> Numbers returns a Numbers whose values are each input value multiplied by 2, in the same order.

Records: Command {name: Text}, Reply {text: Text}. Workflow main(command: Command) -> Reply. text is "Starting" when name is "start", "Stopping" when name is "stop", and "Unknown command" for anything else.

Records: Customer {name: Text, vip: Bool}, Item {name: Text, price: Number, quantity: Number}, Order {customer: Customer, items: Item[]}, Invoice {customer: Text, total: Number, discount: Number}. Workflow main(order: Order) -> Invoice. customer is the customer's name. total is the sum of price times quantity over all items. discount is total divided by 10 when the customer is a vip, otherwise 0.

Records: Access {age: Number, member: Bool, banned: Bool}, Decision {allowed: Bool}. Workflow main(access: Access) -> Decision. allowed is true when the person is not banned and is either at least 18 years old or a member.

Records: Reading {celsius: Number}, Temperature {fahrenheit: Number}, Report {fahrenheit: Number, hot: Bool}. Workflow convert(reading: Reading) -> Temperature converts Celsius to Fahrenheit (celsius * 9 / 5 + 32). Workflow main(reading: Reading) -> Report must call the convert workflow, then return the Fahrenheit value and hot, which is true when Fahrenheit is above 86.

Records: Question {text: Text}, Answer {text: Text}. Declare a model named assistant that takes a Question and returns an Answer. Workflow main(question: Question) -> Answer asks the model once with the question text and returns its answer.

Records: Ticket {text: Text}, Label {category: Text, confidence: Number}, Routing {queue: Text, escalate: Bool}. Declare a model named classifier that takes a Ticket and returns a Label. Workflow main(ticket: Ticket) -> Routing asks the classifier, then returns queue equal to the category and escalate true when confidence is below 0.6.

Records: Topic {title: Text}, Draft {text: Text}, Final {text: Text, approved: Bool}. Declare a model named drafter (Topic in, Draft out) and a model named editor (Draft in, Final out). Workflow main(topic: Topic) -> Final asks drafter with the topic title, passes the draft text to editor, and returns the editor's Final.

Records: Document {body: Text}, Summary {text: Text}. Declare a model named summarizer (Document in, Summary out) with deployment "local-summarizer", temperature 0.2 and a maximum of 200 output tokens. Workflow main(document: Document) -> Summary asks the summarizer with the document body and returns its Summary.

Records: City {name: Text}, Weather {celsius: Number, conditions: Text}. Declare a read-only tool named get_weather from MCP source "weather" with operation "current", taking a City and returning Weather. Declare an agent named forecaster that may use get_weather. Workflow main(city: City) -> Weather has the forecaster call get_weather with the city name and returns the result.

Records: Sku {code: Text}, Stock {quantity: Number}, Availability {in_stock: Bool, quantity: Number}. Declare a read-only tool named lookup_stock from MCP source "inventory" with operation "lookup", taking a Sku and returning Stock. Declare an agent named clerk that may use lookup_stock. Workflow main(sku: Sku) -> Availability has the clerk look up the sku code, then returns the quantity and in_stock, which is true when the quantity is above 0.

Record: Log {lines: Text[]}. Declare a read-only tool named read_log from MCP source "logs" with operation "read", taking no input and returning a Log. Declare an agent named auditor that may use read_log and is explicitly denied delete_log and shell. Workflow main() -> Log has the auditor read the log and returns it.

Records: Email {to: Text, subject: Text}, Receipt {sent: Bool}. Declare a tool named send_email from MCP source "mail" with operation "send" that changes the outside world (it is not read-only), taking an Email and returning a Receipt. Declare an agent named messenger that may use send_email. Workflow main(email: Email) -> Receipt has the messenger send the email. The program must pass the checker; it will not be run.

Records: Question {text: Text}, SearchRequest {query: Text}, SearchHit {source: Text, excerpt: Text}, SearchResults {hits: SearchHit[]}, Answer {text: Text, sources: Text[]}. Declare a model named reader (Question in, Answer out). Declare a read-only tool named search_docs from MCP source "documents" with operation "search", taking a SearchRequest and returning SearchResults. Declare an agent named researcher that uses the reader model, may use search_docs, is denied write_files, and is limited to 4 steps. Workflow main(question: Question) -> Answer asks the researcher agent with the question text and returns its Answer.

Record: Brief {text: Text}. Declare a model named writer_model (Brief in, Brief out). Declare an agent named writer that uses writer_model. Workflow refine(brief: Brief) -> Brief asks the writer agent with the brief text and returns the improved Brief. Declare a swarm named Panel whose only member is writer, which runs the refine workflow for at most 2 rounds. The program must pass the checker; it will not be run.
